acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Minotaurs family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Bull Emperor, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Shattered-Arena Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Gateway-wide horn arc, bronze slab armor, family-native brazier-like eye glow, cape of hides, massive command axe, and shattered arena floor define the sovereign rather than size alone.

Signature mechanic: Imperial Labyrinth: five bronze horn bands correspond to five shattered arena gates. The Emperor points its massive greataxe to assign Bull-kin to a hinge, Chargers to a lane, a Labyrinth Warrior to rotate a gate wall, or an Arena Champion to orbit a central block. The family-native brazier-like eye glow brightens only as a ceremonial command tell. After each formation resolves, the responsible band unlocks on the inside horn; breaking it drops one gate, removes that command, and cracks away one slab of bronze armor. At two gates the Emperor abandons command and makes slow, cape-dragging horn sweeps across the open floor.
battlefieldDuty: Command a five-gate boss arena, using gateway-wide horn arcs to rotate wall, charge, and orbit patterns until each broken horn band removes a gate and strips the imperial phase.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity horn, bronze, hewn stone, chain, coarse hide, arena dust, impact sparks, and the Bull Emperor's brazier-like eye glow remain physical or ceremonial motifs rather than Fire or Earth affinity evidence.
Motion stays mass-driven: hooves chip flooring, chains pull taut, weapons lag behind turns, and dust follows impacts without supernatural wake or material transformation.
counterplay: Use the named lower-form response, cross behind the loaded horn, and break the unlocked inner band; every broken band permanently opens an arena route and removes one imperial command. Affinity signal: The loaded hoof, inside horn, weapon chain, or harness buckle remains visibly exposed during each committed line.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating ordinary bronze, stone weapons, impact sparks, or brazier-like T5 eye glow as affinity construction
identityInvariants: A bull head, bovine snout and ears, wide horns, vastly overbuilt humanoid torso, digitigrade hooved legs, and thick tail remain legible at every tier.
Deep russet and black hide, bronze, ox-blood red, and bone define the family palette.
Coarse hair, horn, bronze, heavy leather harness, chain, and hewn stone remain distinct load-bearing materials.
Nose rings, horn caps, brands, arena trophies, and chained slabs communicate rank through visible history and repairs.
Weapon mass and horn spread always preserve a readable commitment direction and recovery side.
telegraph: One horn band rings, the hide cape pulls toward its matching gate, the brazier-like eyes brighten without flame, and the chosen lower form takes its learned starting posture.
